<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%" ALIGN="justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>Mark Zuckerberg </I>is our
founder and has served as our CEO and as a member of our board of directors since July 2004. Mr.&nbsp;Zuckerberg has served as Chairman of our board of directors since January 2012. Mr. Zuckerberg attended Harvard University where he studied
computer science. We believe that Mr.&nbsp;Zuckerberg should serve as a member of our board of directors due to the perspective and experience he brings as our founder, Chairman, and CEO, and as our largest and controlling stockholder. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%" ALIGN="justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>Sheryl K. Sandberg</I> has
served as our Chief Operating Officer since March 2008. From November 2001 to March 2008, Ms.&nbsp;Sandberg served in various positions at Google, Inc., most recently as Vice President, Global Online Sales&nbsp;&amp; Operations. Ms.&nbsp;Sandberg
also is a former Chief of Staff of the U.S. Treasury Department and previously served as a consultant with McKinsey&nbsp;&amp; Company, a management consulting company, and as an economist with The World Bank. In addition to serving as our Chief
Operating Officer, Ms.&nbsp;Sandberg has been a member of the board of directors of the Walt Disney Company since December 2009. Ms.&nbsp;Sandberg holds an A.B. in economics from Harvard University and an M.B.A. from Harvard Business School.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%" ALIGN="justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>David A.
Ebersman </I>has served as our Chief Financial Officer since September 2009. Prior to joining us, Mr.&nbsp;Ebersman served in various positions at Genentech, Inc., a biotechnology company, including as its Chief Financial Officer from March 2005 and
as an Executive Vice President from January 2006 until April 2009, following Genentech&#146;s acquisition by F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. in March 2009. Prior to joining Genentech, Mr.&nbsp;Ebersman was a research analyst at Oppenheimer&nbsp;&amp;
Company, Inc., an investment company. In addition to serving as our Chief Financial Officer, Mr.&nbsp;Ebersman has been a member of the board of directors of Ironwood Pharmaceuticals, Inc. since July 2009. Mr.&nbsp;Ebersman holds an A.B. in
economics and international relations from Brown University. </FONT></P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">
<h5 align="left"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></h5>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%" ALIGN="justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>David B. Fischer</I> joined us in April 2010 and serves
as our Vice President, Marketing and Business Partnerships. From July 2002 to March 2010, Mr.&nbsp;Fischer served in various positions at Google, including most recently as its Vice President, Global Online Sales&nbsp;&amp; Operations. Prior to
joining Google, Mr.&nbsp;Fischer served as Deputy Chief of Staff of the U.S. Treasury Department and was an associate editor at the U.S. News World Report, L.P., a news magazine company. Mr.&nbsp;Fischer holds a B.A. in government from Cornell
University and an M.B.A. from the Stanford University Graduate School of Business. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%" ALIGN="justify"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>Mike Schroepfer </I>has served as our Vice President of Engineering since September 2008. From December 2005 to August 2008, Mr.&nbsp;Schroepfer served as Vice President of Engineering
at Mozilla Corporation, an Internet company. Prior to Mozilla, Mr.&nbsp;Schroepfer served in various positions at Sun Microsystems, Inc., an information technology company, including as Chief Technology Officer of its data center automation
division. He also co-founded CenterRun, Inc., a developer of application provisioning software, which was acquired by Sun Microsystems. In addition to serving as our Vice President of Engineering, Mr.&nbsp;Schroepfer has been a member of the board
of directors of Ancestry.com Inc. since January 2011. Mr.&nbsp;Schroepfer holds a B.S. and an M.S. in computer science from Stanford University. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%" ALIGN="justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>Theodore W. Ullyot</I> has served as our Vice President, General Counsel, and Secretary since October
2008. From May 2008 to October 2008, Mr.&nbsp;Ullyot was a partner at Kirkland&nbsp;&amp; Ellis LLP, a law firm. From October 2005 to April 2008, Mr.&nbsp;Ullyot served as Executive Vice President and General Counsel of ESL Investments, Inc., a
private investment firm. Prior to joining ESL Investments, Mr.&nbsp;Ullyot served in the federal executive branch under President George W. Bush, including as Chief of Staff at the U.S. Justice Department and as a Deputy Assistant to the President.
Earlier in his career, Mr.&nbsp;Ullyot was an associate general counsel at AOL Time Warner, Inc. and served as a law clerk for U.S. Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia and for Judge Michael Luttig of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth
Circuit. Mr.&nbsp;Ullyot holds an A.B. in History from Harvard University and a J.D. from the University of Chicago. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%" ALIGN="justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>Marc L. Andreessen </I>has served as a member of our board of directors since June 2008.
Mr.&nbsp;Andreessen is a co-founder and has been a General Partner of Andreessen Horowitz, a venture capital firm, since July 2009. Previously, Mr.&nbsp;Andreessen co-founded and served as the Chairman of the board of directors of Opsware, Inc.
(formerly known as Loudcloud Inc.), a software company. He also served as Chief Technology Officer of America Online, Inc., an Internet services company. Mr.&nbsp;Andreessen was a co-founder of Netscape Communications Corporation, a software
company, serving in various positions, including Chief Technology Officer and Executive Vice President of Products. In addition to serving on our board of directors, Mr.&nbsp;Andreessen currently serves as a member of the boards of directors of eBay
Inc. and the Hewlett-Packard Company. Mr.&nbsp;Andreessen holds a B.S. in computer science from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. We believe that Mr.&nbsp;Andreessen should serve as a member of our board of directors due to his
extensive experience as an Internet entrepreneur, venture capitalist, and technologist. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%" ALIGN="justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>Erskine B. Bowles</I> has served as a member of our board of directors since September 2011.
Mr.&nbsp;Bowles is President Emeritus of the University of North Carolina and served as President from January 2006 through December 2010. Mr.&nbsp;Bowles has also been a Senior Advisor of BDT Capital Partners, LLC, a private investment firm, since
January 2012. From February 2010 until December 2010, he served as Co-Chair of the National Commission on Fiscal Responsibility and Reform. Mr.&nbsp;Bowles has been a Senior Advisor since 2001 and was Managing Director from 1999 to 2001 of Carousel
Capital LLC, a private investment firm. He was also a partner of Forstmann Little&nbsp;&amp; Co., an investment firm, from 1999 to 2001. Mr.&nbsp;Bowles began his career in corporate finance at Morgan Stanley and subsequently helped found and
ultimately served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Bowles Hollowell Connor&nbsp;&amp; Co., an investment banking firm. He also was a founder of Kitty Hawk Capital, a venture capital firm. Mr.&nbsp;Bowles served as White House Chief of
Staff from 1996 to 1998 and Deputy White House Chief of Staff from 1994 to 1995. In addition to serving on our board of directors, Mr.&nbsp;Bowles currently serves as a member of the boards of directors of Morgan Stanley, Belk, Inc., and Norfolk
Southern Corporation. Mr.&nbsp;Bowles also served as a member of the board of directors of General Motors Company from June 2005 to April 2009 and Cousins Properties Incorporated from August 2003 to May 2012.

STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2" COLOR="#32406b"><I>Peter A. Thiel </I>has served as a member of our board of directors since April 2005. Since 2005, Mr.&nbsp;Thiel has been a Partner of Founders Fund, a venture capital firm.

B.A. in Philosophy from Stanford University and a J.D. from Stanford Law School. We believe that Mr.&nbsp;Thiel should serve as a member of our board of directors due to his extensive experience as an entrepreneur and venture capitalist, and as one
